main_text.p: Gall. chevalier : est enim vocabulum ignotum & peregrinum.

[Hebrew] Ch. Volvere, convolvere, devolvere, involvere. Pabel [Hebrew] Idem, Genef.29.3.10. in T. Jonath. Ithpah. [Hebrew] Jobi 30.14. & ex altera forma, [Hebrew] Volvi, covolvi, devolvi, Hof.11.8. Gen.43.30.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic words are printed in Hebrew letters and rendered here only as placeholders; several vowel points and small superscript letters are doubtful. The word "Rota-" at the foot is a catchword continuing onto the next page. The printed Galilæus line and the Pabel/Ithpah forms are approximate.
